mapper.select: SELECT cr.id as room_id, cr.name as room_name, cr.is_group as is_group, cfg.last_summary, msg.content as last_message_content, msg.sent_at as last_message_time FROM chat_room cr LEFT JOIN chat_room_ai_config cfg ON cr.id = cfg.room_id JOIN chat_room_member crm ON cr.id = crm.room_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL( SELECT m1.room_id, m1.content, m1.sent_at FROM chat_message m1 WHERE m1.room_id = cr.id AND ( (m1.is_ai_called = false AND m1.is_ai_generated = false) OR m1.sender_no = #{employeeNo} ) ORDER BY m1.sent_at DESC, m1.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) msg ON true WHERE crm.employee_no = #{employeeNo} AND cr.is_group = true ORDER BY msg.sent_at DESC NULLS LAST
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_message (room_id, sender_no, parent_message_id, content, message_type, is_ai_called, is_ai_generated, ai_metadata, sent_at) VALUES (#{chatRoom.id}, #{senderNo}, #{parentMessageId}, #{content}, #{messageType}, #{isAiCalled}, #{isAiGenerated}, CAST(#{aiMetadataJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS jsonb), #{sentAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM (SELECT id, room_id, sender_no, parent_message_id, content, sent_at, message_type, is_ai_called, is_ai_generated FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND ( (is_ai_called = false AND is_ai_generated = false) OR sender_no = #{userNo} ) ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}) AS sub ORDER BY sent_at ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room_ai_config (room_id, is_ai_active, summary_enabled, last_summary, last_summarized_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{roomId}, true, true, #{summary}, #{lastSummarizedId}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (room_id) DO UPDATE SET summary_enabled = true, last_summary = EXCLUDED.last_summary, last_summarized_id = EXCLUDED.last_summarized_id, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT cr.id as room_id, cr.name as room_name, cr.is_group, (SELECT m.content FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_id = cr.id AND ( (m.is_ai_called = false AND m.is_ai_generated = false) OR m.sender_no = #{employeeNo} ) ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC LIMIT 1) as last_message_content, (SELECT m.sent_at FROM chat_message m WHERE m.room_id = cr.id AND ( (m.is_ai_called = false AND m.is_ai_generated = false) OR m.sender_no = #{employeeNo} ) ORDER BY m.sent_at DESC LIMIT 1) as last_message_time FROM chat_room cr JOIN chat_room_member crm ON cr.id = crm.room_id WHERE crm.employee_no = #{employeeNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_room_member (room_id, employee_no, joined_at) VALUES (#{chatRoom.id}, #{employeeNo}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT m1.room_id FROM chat_room_member m1 JOIN chat_room_member m2 ON m1.room_id = m2.room_id JOIN chat_room cr ON m1.room_id = cr.id WHERE cr.is_group = false AND m1.employee_no = #{currentUserNo} AND m2.employee_no = #{targetNo} LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM chat_message WHERE room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT cr.id as room_id, cr.name as room_name, cr.is_group as is_group FROM chat_room cr WHERE cr.id = #{id}
